_about: Real sneakers researched online in November 2026. Price is the US retail price listed on the StockX product page (source); stock numbers are demo values. image_url is the StockX product photo; the importer downloads it. crop 'pad' places the wide shoe photo on a white square so the whole shoe shows on the product card.
